notes.title: Release Content 1.0
notes.notes:
[u][b]NEW:[/b][/u]

[b]JUMP SCARE TRAP ( Props )[/b]

[list]
[*] Each prop player has 1 jump scare trap. Simply place this down near codes, doorways, or anywhere.
[/list]

[b]EMP Grenade ( Hunted )[/b]

[list]
[*] Each Hunter has 2 EMP grenades that knock surrounding props out of their prop form and silencing them for 1 second
[*] Silence is a new mechanic that prevents props from using any ability besides their melee attack
[/list]


[u][b]HUNTED:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Increased hunted's glowstick throw speed from 1500 to 2000
[*] Flickering flashlight events are now much quicker and random
[*] Fixed a bug that caused glowsticks to go through the ground or walls
[*] Now spawn with flashlight ON
[/list]


[u][b]PROP:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Changed prop line trace detection to turn into prop from 600 to 700 (Can change into prop much further away now)
[*] Decreased the rate at which nightvision is used. (Nightvision lasts roughly 25 percent longer)
[*] Reworked the appearance of nightvision (Again)
[*] Fixed a bug where being hit while in nightvision will remove the green effect
[*] Prop rotation is now set to mouse wheel up and down. No longer needed to lock in place
[*] Melee damage increased from 20 to 25


[/list]

[u][b]GAMEPLAY:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] At the beginning of the round the map is lit up so props can setup without nightvision This gradually degrades until Blindfold phase is over
[*] Fixed Explosion trap spawning for clients
[*] Added nameplates above player's heads (This only shows for teammates)
[*] Being hit by a prop's throwing dagger will now removed the Hunted from the keypad door if it's being used
[*] Added an "Interact" text to the code door when close by
[*] [b]Entering the wrong code will now kill you (Guess wisely)[/b]
[/list]

[u][b]HUD:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Implemented Key Bindings 1.0 in the settings
[*] Added "How To Play" on the Main Menu
[*] When glowstick count is 0, text is changed to red within the Hunted HUD
[*] When traps count is 0, text is changed to red within the Hunted HUD
[*] When EMP count is 0, text is changed to red within the Hunted HUD
[*] When Health count is 25 or below, text is changed to red within the Hunted HUD
[*] When traps count is 0, text is changed to red within the Prop HUD
[*] When Health count is 25 or below, text is changed to red within the Prop HUD
[*] Added trap count in Prop's HUD
[*] Added new sound once the round hits 45 seconds remaining and below
[*] Added silence bar for when silenced
[*] Seconds timer's color changed to red once round hits 45 seconds remaining and below
[*] Fixed the alignment of the options menu to be centered
[*] Optimized and improved scoreboard
[*] Optimized and improved kill feed
[/list]

[u][b]SOUND:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Now a notification and sound when the round begins
[*] Ambient Low "Hum" during the rounds has been EQ'd to include less bass
[*] Created EMP grenade trail sound
[*] Created EMP grenade blast sound
[*] Main Menu BGM EQ'd for less bass and better looping
[*] Improved Thunder sounds on map: Warehouse
[/list]


[u][b]KEEP IN MIND:[/b][/u]

[b]1.0 brings new content to mix things up in Horror Hunt. These two new tools are implemented to be tested and have feedback on their impact of the game. Be mindful that these tools are subject to change for the sake of balancing or even removed.[/b]

notes.title: Patch Version 0.5.3
notes.notes:
Gameplay:

Further generalized optimizations

HUD:

Fixed scoreboard alignment
Temporarily removed dying from entering wrong code (Re-doing / Fixing breaking bug)

Hunted:

When ammo reaches 10 or below the text color is now changed to red
Code colors are now yellow text
Separated codes text from ammo text

Prop:

Reduced throwing dagger's damage from 15 to 5
Reduced melee attack's damage from 25 to 20
Trying to stealth while transformed into a prop will now automatically remove prop and stealth (QoL)


Maps:

Fixed prop offset of bookshelf on map Office
Fixed prop offset of cupboard on map Office

Improved ambient loop


HUNTED:

PROP:

Reworked nightvision's appearance.
No longer in locked rotation state when transforming out of prop (QOL)


OTHER:

Fixed bed collisions on map: Hotel

notes.title: Patch Version 0.5.1
notes.notes:
Temporarily removed doors from maps. (Reworking)
Improved numerous network optimizations.
Improved animation optimizations.

Names in chat now represent Prop (Blue) or Hunted (Red)
Removed ping from join server


--- Hunted ---

Increased gun damage from 10 to 15
Increased Explosive trap beam range from 1000 - 1200
Explosive trap now ignores beam trace from owner when being placed
Can pick up your placed trap with "Interact" (E by default)
Improved glowstick replication.


--- Props ---

Reduced movement speed from 700 to 600
Increased throwing dagger cooldown from 5 to 6
Increased stealth cooldown from 10 to 12
Penalty from throwing dagger reduced from 5 seconds to 3.
Fixed a big where props were able to attack while transformed.



Other issues.
If playing and having stuttering network issues please go into C:\ Users\ YOURNAME\ AppData\ Local\ HorrorHunt and delete the "Saved" folder then restart game.
Game has been locked to 60 fps for now. Different max fps' between client and host causes network problems.
